title: [Community Publisher Access List ] Add aadirajuthup , Jonakss and suniyintellekt998114-star to the list
author: gggff123

gist.headline: Three more in the garden
gist.blurb: The community publisher list has three new names. Polli made room on the clipboard.
gist.summary: Added aadirajuthup, Jonakss, and suniyintellekt998114-star to the community publisher GitHub ID access list in shared/auth/github-id-list.ts.
gist.impact: These three contributors are now included in the list used to authorize community publishers.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli welcoming three contributors, represented by small name badges, into a cozy garden workspace. A clipboard marked “PUBLISHERS” represents the GitHub ID access list; the scene is about granting access, not a security incident.
gist.image_prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden workspace, Polli adds three small name badges to a clipboard marked “PUBLISHERS” beside lime green (#ecf874) code-plants and a warm cream-to-mint pastel background. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she wears a tiny librarian hat, is small-to-medium in the scene, and is strictly pixel art, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, chunky sprites, dark purple (#110518) outlines, subtle CRT glow, nostalgic and emotionally warm.
